description: A wedge of violet crystal with a white heart. Snapped off Amethyrn's crown, which it will regrow.
lore: It grows back, and that changed how it is taken. There is no sense breaking a shape that will hand you another wedge in two years, so the crown men break nothing: they come in at the shoulder while it feeds, tap once at the base with a wooden mallet, and walk out. Twice a decade, same animal. They call it husbandry and they are not entirely wrong.

[[monsters/crystal_horn|The bull]] on the high pasture has been tapped nine times. It has started coming when the whistle goes. The young men take this as a compliment and tell it in company. The old ones have stopped drinking to it, because they know what it looks like when a thing keeps [[lore/the_quiet|walking a round]] it no longer has any reason for, and this season they sent the young men up alone.
gm_notes: The bull is not tame. It is at Habit and the crown men are the only remaining shape of its day. Never state this in shipped text; the old men declining to toast it is the whole tell.
